text: Velkomin á Stjörnuhátíðina! Ég er DJ Flugeðla!
en: Welcome to the Star Festival! I'm DJ Flugeðla!
how: big and bright, a smile in the voice, as she lands at the decks; a small pause between the two sentences
where: beat 2, the intro, over her wing beats as she lands (an echo throw on 'Flugeðla')

how: four short punchy words, a clear little gap after each (each word is cut out and put on its own beat), the last one biggest
where: beats 12, 13, 14, 15: the count-in to the first drop (the same words are used backwards later for the take-off countdown: þrír, tveir, einn)

text: Hæ, Egill! Í kvöld förum við í leiki!
en: Hi, Egill! Tonight we play games!
how: warm and excited, talking straight to him
where: beat 18, as the dance floor starts

how: big and heavy, laughing, the second word like a stomp
where: beat 80, as the grazers' half-time stomp drops

how: delighted, wobbly with laughter
where: beat 88, between the stomps

how: slow and low and drawn out, like slow motion, holding back a giggle
where: beat 96, as the music drops into a slow half-time for the turtles

how: sudden, sharp and loud, a surprise (the joke: the slow turtles suddenly go fast)
where: beat 104, as the turtles' part jumps to double time

how: shouted, laughing
where: beat 112, as the frogs' part drops

how: one short bouncy shout, a jump in the voice
where: beats 120, 121, 122, 123 and 126, 127: one take fired on each beat with a frog croak and a boing (Egill jumps on each)

how: quick and excited
where: beat 128, as the lizards' part goes double time

how: one quick excited shout, loving the speed
where: beats 136, 138, 140, 141 (fired again and again, quicker each time, with a short echo)

how: bright, looking up, the second word rising
where: beat 144, as the flyers whistle

how: one bright rising shout
where: beats 148, 152, 156: each time the flyers jump up an octave (their own tone, higher and higher)

how: a game-show shout, huge fun, the host starting the game
where: beat 160, as everyone dances together

how: sharp and loud but friendly, like the start of a game
where: beats 168 and 184: the music freezes (a held chord and a clock tick on the beat) and everyone freezes

how: laughing, teasing kindly
where: beat 170, in the first freeze, after one slow turtle keeps humming

how: a big release, everyone go
where: beats 175 and 191: the pickup back into the music after each freeze

how: playful, almost a stage whisper, full of fun suspense
where: beat 185, in the second freeze

how: warm and kind, softer, with a smile (she is shy)
where: beat 204, as the dance thins out before her horn plays her tune

how: big and rising, getting everyone to lift their wings
where: beat 240, as the take-off build starts with her wing beats

how: excited, wind in the voice, as in chapter 4 before the flight
where: beat 256, the wind rising in the build

how: the biggest shout of the song, joyful, as in chapter 4 when she took off
where: beat 272, the big drop (after the countdown þrír, tveir, einn on beats 269 to 271)

how: wild with joy, laughing on 'Jibbí'
where: beat 302, into the last time everyone sings her tune; 'Jibbí' is fired again at the top, beat 328

how: surprised and laughing, the last word a happy groan of 'at last'
where: beat 344, in the last held chord, as a tiny snail slides in late to the party (a slide whistle)
